name: spikypanda-harness-design
description: Graphe de décision exécutable sur les sessions Core et les slots MCP

scripts.test:decision: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=15000 tests/decision-runtime.test.mjs tests/decision-broker.test.mjs tests/broker-slots.test.mjs
scripts.test:agents: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=15000 tests/conduct-delegation.test.mjs tests/delegation-broker.test.mjs
scripts.test:harness-onnx: npm run build:proposal && node --test LLMLingua2/harness-flow/slot-routing.test.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=12288 LLMLingua2/gpu-node/run-model.mjs high-performance --harness-flow
scripts.test:harness-relay: npm run build:proposal && node --test LLMLingua2/harness-flow/relay.test.mjs LLMLingua2/harness-flow/relay-gpu.test.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=12288 LLMLingua2/gpu-node/run-model.mjs high-performance --harness-relay
scripts.test:gameplay-mlp: node gameplay-mlp/direct.mjs high-performance && node gameplay-mlp/direct.mjs low-power
scripts.test:gameplay-mlp:worker: node gameplay-mlp/run.mjs high-performance && node gameplay-mlp/run.mjs low-power
scripts.test:gameplay-mlp:batch20: node gameplay-mlp/direct.mjs high-performance --batch20 && node gameplay-mlp/direct.mjs low-power --batch20
